extDescription.message: Blocks ads on Twitch: ad breaks in the stream, display ads around the player and the prompts to allow ads.

enabledDesc.message: Main switch for everything on Twitch.

reloadHint.message: Reload Twitch for the change to take effect.

streamAds.message: Block ad breaks in the stream

streamAdsDesc.message: Swaps ads in the stream for an ad-free version of it (vaft). While it does, the player shows “Blocking ads” in the top left.

displayAdsDesc.message: Removes ad banners next to and below the player, blocks the ad servers and hides the prompt to allow ads or buy Turbo.

claimBonusDesc.message: Clicks the bonus box below the chat as soon as it shows up.

toastSavedReload.message: Saved. Reload open Twitch tabs for it to take effect.
